utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start spreading the word and ask around for volunteers right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll send the updated details now — it’s moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Ira

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, Rosa — I’ll look for the supply list and house-check schedule on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update before I pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll check in while I’m out and let you know what still needs fixing and by when.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update and then I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Faye — I’ll have the tools ready for you after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I appreciate it — see you right after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’m still only hearing bits and pieces, so I’d appreciate any update you find.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ve only skimmed it, but they’re still sorting the list of repairs and who can help. I’ll let you know if I hear anything concrete.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’m still getting the scraps of it, so any concrete update would really help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’ve got some screwdrivers, tape, and a few nails — I’ll check for spare wood and labels too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, that covers a lot—just let me know once you check for the spare wood and labels, and I’ll update the supplies list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll check my shed and send you the spare wood and labels if I find them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check who’s available and send a quick update. 3 PM works for me too.

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Eli

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, Eli — I’m on it and should have the missing items to you shortly.

utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Sam—thanks for bringing the screwdriver set and gloves. See you Sunday at the community center for the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.text: Tess: You bet, Uli — I’ll keep my ears open and tell you the minute I hear what’s still needed. We’re getting there, nice and steady.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. That means a lot—I’ll keep it quiet on my end too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, Uli — I’ll keep it between us and let you know the second I hear what’s still needed. We’re making steady progress, so no worries.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Perfect — I’ll bring the tools and see you at 9 on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect — just send the list when you have it, and I’ll make sure the right tools are ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — could you start with the donated items and flag anything that looks missing? I really appreciate your help at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure thing — I’ll sort through the donated items and keep an eye out for anything missing. I might need a quick reminder on which tools we’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — we’re still short on screwdrivers, zip ties, and a few small wrenches. I’ll give you a quick rundown when you get there!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that’s perfect. We’re now meeting Sunday at the community center, so bring the tools there and we’ll start with sorting and replacements.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do, Rosa — I’ll bring the tools to the community center on Sunday and start sorting out what needs replacing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that sounds great. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center, and we’ll keep the repair drive moving smoothly.
